title: Parkin - Julie's Parkin
preamble:
Ingredients:-
150g
brown sugar
150g
butter
150g
self-raising flour
150g
oatmeal
1
teaspoon ground ginger
1
teaspoon mixed spice
1
teaspoon baking powder
2
tablespoons treacle or golden syrup
1
egg
1
teacup milk

1

1
teacup milk

Method:-
Pre-heat oven to 350f/Gas Mark 4
Cream butter and sugar together.
Add flour, oatmeal and spices.
Stir in treacle.
Add beaten egg and milk and mix thoroughly.
Pour into greased and lined tin
Bake for about 45 minutes
Cut into squares when cool
